verses.geez: እስመ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሰብእ፡ እለ፡ ሕፀተ፡ አእምሮ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ህልው፡ ውስቴቶሙ፡ በአማን፡ ከንቱ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ወበዘያስተርእዩ፡ ሠናያት፡ ስእኑ፡ ያእምሩ፡ ዘህልው፡ ወእንዘሂ፡ ይሬእዩ፡ ምግባራቲሁ፡ ኢያእመርዎ፡ ለኬንያ።
verses.translation: Surely vain are all men by nature, who are ignorant of God, and could not out of the good things that are seen know him that is: neither by considering the works did they acknowledge the workmaster;

translations.lxx: Surely vain are all men by nature, who are ignorant of God, and could not out of the good things that are seen know him that is: neither by considering the works did they acknowledge the workmaster;
translations.ron: Deşerţi sunt din fire toţi oamenii care nu cunosc pe Dumnezeu şi care n-au ştiut, plecând de la bunătăţile văzute, să vadă pe Cel care este, nici din cercetarea lucrurilor Sale să înţeleagă pe meşter;
translations.grk: Μάταιοι μὲν γὰρ πάντες ἄνθρωποι φύσει, οἷς παρῆν Θεοῦ ἀγνωσία, καὶ ἐκ τῶν ὁρομένων ἀγαθῶν οὐκ ἴσχυσαν εἰδέναι τὸν ὄντα, οὔτε τοῖς ἔργοις προσχόντες ἐπέγνωσαν τὸν τεχνίτην.

verses.geez: ወባሕቱ፡ ሐለዩ፡ እሳተ፡ ወነፋሰ፡ ዘፍጡነ፡ አው፡ ዑደተ፡ ከዋክብት፡ አው፡ ማየ፡ ኅዩለ፡ አው፡ ብርሃናተ፡ ሰማይ፡ እለ፡ ይትለአኩ፡ ለሥርዓተ፡ ዓለም፡ አማልክተ፡ አምሰሉ።
verses.translation: but deemed either fire, or wind, or the swift air, or the circle of the stars, or the violent water, or the lights of heaven, to be the gods which govern the world.

translations.lxx: but deemed either fire, or wind, or the swift air, or the circle of the stars, or the violent water, or the lights of heaven, to be the gods which govern the world.
translations.ron: Ci au socotit că sunt dumnezei cârmuitori ai lumii sau focul, sau vântul, sau arcul cel iute, sau mersul stelelor, sau apa năvalnică, sau luminătorii cerului;
translations.grk: Ἀλλʼ ἢ πῦρ, ἢ πνεῦμα, ἢ ταχινὸν ἀέρα, ἢ κύκλον ἄστρων, ἢ βίαιον ὕδωρ, ἢ φωστῆρας οὐρανοῦ, πρυτάνεις κόσμου θεοὺς ἐνόμισαν.

verses.geez: ወለእመ፡ ለእሉ፡ ምግባራት፡ ረሰይዎሙ፡ አማልክተ፡ ሶበ፡ ተፈሥሑ፡ በአድሞ፡ ሥነ፡ ላህዮሙ፡ ያእምሩ፡ እፎ፡ ፈድፋደ፡ እግዚኦሙ፡ ለእሉ፡ ይኄይስ፡ እስመ፡ ወላዴ፡ ሥነ፡ ገብረ፡ ዘንተ፡ ፍጥረተ።
verses.translation: With whose beauty if they being delighted took them to be gods; let them know how much better the Lord of them is: for the first author of beauty hath created them.

translations.lxx: With whose beauty if they being delighted took them to be gods; let them know how much better the Lord of them is: for the first author of beauty hath created them.
translations.ron: Ei, care, desfătaţi de frumuseţea acestora, le-au luat drept dumnezei, să ştie acum cu cât este Stăpânul mai presus decât acestea, că El, Cel Care Însuşi este începătorul frumuseţii, este făcătorul lor.
translations.grk: Ὧν εἰ μὲν τῇ καλλονῇ τερπόμενοι, θεοὺς ὑπελάμβανον, γνώτωσαν πόσῳ τούτων ὁ δεσπότης ἐστὶ βελτίων· ὁ γὰρ τοῦ κάλλους γενεσιάρχης ἔκτισεν αὐτά.

verses.geez: ወሶበሰ፡ እምኃይሎሙ፡ ወምግባሮሙ፡ ተደሙ፡ ይለብዉኬ፡ እፎ፡ ፈድፋደ፡ ዘገብሮሙ፡ ኅዩል፡ ውእቱ።
verses.translation: But if they were astonished at their power and virtue, let them understand by them, how much mightier he is that made them.

translations.lxx: But if they were astonished at their power and virtue, let them understand by them, how much mightier he is that made them.
translations.ron: Iar dacă se minunează de putere şi de lucrare, să înţeleagă din acestea cu cât este mai puternic Cel care le-a făcut.
translations.grk: Εἰ δὲ δύναμιν καὶ ἐνέργειαν ἐκπλαγέντες, νοησάτωσαν ἀπʼ αὐτῶν πόσῳ ὁ κατασκευάσας αὐτὰ δυνατώτερός ἐστιν.

verses.geez: ቦዑ፡ ዕበየ፡ ሥነ፡ ዘፍጥረት፡ ርእዮሙ፡ ፍቱራን፡ ቦቱ፡ አስተማሰልዎ፡ ለገባሬ፡ ክዋኔሁ።
verses.translation: For by the greatness and beauty of the creatures proportionably the maker of them is seen.

translations.lxx: For by the greatness and beauty of the creatures proportionably the maker of them is seen.
translations.ron: Căci din mărimea şi frumuseţea făpturilor poţi să cunoşti bine, socotindu-te, pe Cel care le-a zidit.
translations.grk: Ἐκ γὰρ μεγέθους καλλονῆς κτισμάτων ἀναλόγως ὁ γενεσιουργὸς αὐτῶν θεωρεῖται.

verses.geez: ወባሕቱ፡ ምስለ፡ ዝኒ፡ ዓዲ፡ ኂስ፡ ንስቲት፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ እስመ፡ እሙንቱሂ፡ እንጋ፡ ሶበ፡ ስሕቱ፡ እንዘ፡ የኃሥሥዎ፡ ለአምላክ፡ ወይፈቅዱ፡ ይርከብዎ፡ ተመይጦ፡ ውስተ፡ ምግባሩ፡ አምኃሠሥዎ።
verses.translation: But yet for this they are the less to be blamed: for they peradventure err, seeking God, and desirous to find him.

translations.lxx: But yet for this they are the less to be blamed: for they peradventure err, seeking God, and desirous to find him.
translations.ron: Dar, în acelaşi timp, în toate acestea este oarecare neajuns, căci doar unii ca aceştia rătăcesc căutând pe Dumnezeu şi străduindu-se să-L afle.
translations.grk: Ἀλλʼ ὅμως ἐπὶ τούτοις ἐστὶ μέμψις ὀλίγη, καὶ γὰρ αὐτοὶ τάχα πλανῶνται Θεὸν ζητοῦντες, καὶ θέλοντες εὑρεῖν.

verses.geez: ወአእከሉ፡ በርእይ፡ እስመ፡ እለ፡ ያስተርእዩ፡ ሠናያን፡ ዓዲ፡ እስመ፡ ምክንያቶሙ፡ ስፉሕ።
verses.translation: For being conversant in his works they search him diligently, and believe their sight: because the things are beautiful that are seen.

translations.lxx: For being conversant in his works they search him diligently, and believe their sight: because the things are beautiful that are seen.
translations.ron: Căci, îndeletnicindu-se cu lucrările lui Dumnezeu şi cercetându-le, ei se încredinţează cu vederea cât de frumoase sunt cele văzute.
translations.grk: Ἐν γὰρ τοῖς ἔργοις αὐτοῦ ἀναστρεφόμενοι διερευνῶσι, καὶ πείθονται τῇ ὄψει, ὅτι καλὰ τὰ βλεπόμενα.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ በዝንቱ፡ ገጽ፡ ዘመጠነዝ፡ ክህሉ፡ ይነጽሩ፡ እስከ፡ ደለዎሙ፡ ጠይቆተ፡ ዓለም፡ ወእመሰ፡ ኢክህሉ፡ ይርደብዎ፡ ለእግዚአ፡ እሉ፡ ፍጡራን።
verses.translation: Howbeit neither are they to be pardoned.

translations.lxx: Howbeit neither are they to be pardoned.
translations.ron: De altă parte, ei n-au cuvânt să li se ierte rătăcirea.

verses.geez: ኅሡራንኬ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ወበውስተ፡ ምግባርኒ፡ ምውት፡ ተስፋሆሙ፡ እለ፡ ጸውዑ፡ ግብረ፡ እደ፡ ሰብእ፡ አማልክተ፡ ዘእምወርቅ፡ ወዘእምብሩር፡ ገብርዎሙ፡ በተኬንዎ፡ ምግባር።
verses.translation: For if they were able to know so much, that they could aim at the world; how did they not sooner find out the Lord thereof?

translations.lxx: For if they were able to know so much, that they could aim at the world; how did they not sooner find out the Lord thereof?
translations.ron: Că dacă au putut să adune atâta învăţătură, ca să cerceteze lumea, cum n-au aflat ei mai degrabă pe Stăpânul lumii?
translations.grk: Εἰ γὰρ τοσοῦτον ἴσχυσαν εἰδέναι, ἵνα δύνωνται στοχάσασθαι τὸν αἰῶνα, τὸν τούτων δεσπότην πῶς τάχιον οὐχ εὗρον;

verses.geez: ወአምሳለ፡ እንስሳ፡ አው፡ እብነ፡ ዘኢይበቊዕ፡ ግብረ፡ እድ፡ ዘትካት።
verses.translation: But miserable are they, and in dead things is their hope, who called them gods, which are the works of men's hands, gold and silver, to shew art in, and resemblances of beasts, or a stone good for nothing, the work of an ancient hand.

translations.lxx: But miserable are they, and in dead things is their hope, who called them gods, which are the works of men's hands, gold and silver, to shew art in, and resemblances of beasts, or a stone good for nothing, the work of an ancient hand.
translations.ron: Dar sunt cu totul ticăloşi şi şi-au pus nădejdea în lucruri fără de viaţă cei care au numit dumnezei lucrurile mâinilor omeneşti, aurul şi argintul cu meşteşug lucrat şi închipuiri de dobitoace sau piatră netrebnică, cioplită de mână de demult.
translations.grk: Ταλαίπωροι δὲ καὶ ἐν νεκροῖς αἱ ἐλπίδες αὐτων, οἵτινες ἐκάλεσαν θεοὺς ἔργα χειρῶν ἀνθρώπων, χρυσὸν καὶ ἄργυρον τέχνης ἐμμελέτημα, καὶ ἀπεικάσματα ζώων, ἢ λίθον ἄχρηστον χειρὸς ἔργον ἀρχαίας.

verses.geez: ወእመኒቦ፡ ጸራቢ፡ ዘይጸርብ፡ ዕጸ፡ ዘያስተርኢ፡ ወዘኢይትሐወስ፡ እስመ፡ ወሠረ፡ ዕፀ፡ ዘሠናይ፡ ሠረፀ፡ ወጸረበ፡ በሥነ፡ ኪኑኵሎ፡ ቅርፍቶ።
verses.translation: Now a carpenter that felleth timber, after he hath sawn down a tree meet for the purpose, and taken off all the bark skilfully round about, and hath wrought it handsomely, and made a vessel thereof fit for the service of man's life;

translations.lxx: Now a carpenter that felleth timber, after he hath sawn down a tree meet for the purpose, and taken off all the bark skilfully round about, and hath wrought it handsomely, and made a vessel thereof fit for the service of man's life;
translations.ron: Un meşter lemnar a tăiat din pădure un lemn bun de lucrat, l-a jupuit de coajă şi apoi cu îndemânarea sa a făcut din el o unealtă folositoare spre slujba vieţii.
translations.grk: Εἰ δὲ καί τις ὑλοτῦμος τέκτων εὐκίνητον φυτὸν ἐκπρίσας, περιέξυσεν εὐμαθῶς πάντα τὸν φλοιὸν αὐτοῦ, καὶ τεχνησέμενος εὐπρεπῶς κατεσκεύασε χρήσιμον σκεῦος εἰς ὑπηρεσίαν ζωῆς,

verses.geez: ወተኬነዎ፡ ሠና፡ ወገብሮ፡ ዘይበቊዕ፡ ንዋየ፡ ለመልእክተ፡ ሕይወት፡ ወፈጸመ፡ ፀሪበ፡ ገግብሩ፡ ዘአስተዋፅኦ፡ ለመልእክተ፡ ሲሲት፡ ወጸግበ።
verses.translation: and after spending the refuse of his work to dress his meat, hath filled himself;

translations.lxx: and after spending the refuse of his work to dress his meat, hath filled himself;
translations.ron: Rămăşiţele de la lemnul lucrat le pune pe foc să îşi fiarbă de mâncare şi îşi potoleşte foamea.
translations.grk: τὰ δὲ ἀποβλήματα τῆς ἐργασίας εἰς ἑτοιμασίαν τροφῆς ἀναλώσας ἐνεπλήσθη,

verses.geez: ወዓዲ፡ ግማደ፡ ዘተርፈ፡ እምዕፅ፡ ዘኢይበቊዕ፡ በምንትኒ፡ ዕፅ፡ ጽኑዕ፡ ወጠዋይ፡ ዘአፅጹቂሁ፡ ኵለሄ፡ ነሢኦ፡ ወጸሪቦ፡ በአስተሐምሞ፡ ግብሩ፡ ወእምዝ፡ ገለፎ፡ በመዋዕለ፡ ጽርዓቱ፡ ወመሰሎ፡ በአምሳለ፡ ሰብእ።
verses.translation: and taking the very refuse among those which served to no use, being a crooked piece of wood, and full of knots, hath carved it diligently when he had nothing else to do, and formed it by the skill of his understanding, and fashioned it to the image of a man;

translations.lxx: and taking the very refuse among those which served to no use, being a crooked piece of wood, and full of knots, hath carved it diligently when he had nothing else to do, and formed it by the skill of his understanding, and fashioned it to the image of a man;
translations.ron: Şi ce-a mai rămas dintr-acestea, nefiind de nici o treabă, pentru că este lemn strâmb şi noduros, îl ciopleşte ca să-i treacă de urât şi, potrivindu-l şi meşteşugindu-l, l-a făcut asemenea cu chipul de om.
translations.grk: τὸ δὲ ἐξ αὐτῶν ἀπόβλημα εἰς οὐθὲν εὔχρηστον, ξύλον σκολιὸν, καὶ ὄζοις συμπεφυκὸς, λαβὼν ἔγλυψεν ἐν ἐπιμελείᾳ ἀργίας αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐμπειρίᾳ συνέσεως ἐτύπωσεν αὐτὸ, ἀπείκασεν αὐτὸ εἰκόνι ἀνθρώπου,

verses.geez: አው፡ አስተማሰሎ፡ በእንስሳ፡ ከንቱ፡ ወቀብዖ፡ በኅጒሬ፡ ወሤረዮ፡ ወአቅየሐይሖ፡ በአጽፋር፡ ወመልአ፡ ጥላቄ፡ ዘቦቱ።
verses.translation: or made it like some vile beast, laying it over with vermilion, and with paint colouring it red, and colouring every spot therein;

translations.lxx: or made it like some vile beast, laying it over with vermilion, and with paint colouring it red, and colouring every spot therein;
translations.ron: Sau l-a făcut asemenea vreunui dobitoc de nimic şi, vopsindu-l peste tot şi rumenindu-l la faţă cu vopsea roşie, i-a ascuns toate metehnele.
translations.grk: ἢ ζώῳ τινὶ εὐτελεῖ ὡμοίωσεν αὐτὸ, καταχρίσας μίλτῳ, καὶ φύκει ἐρυθῄνας χρόαν αὐτοῦ, καὶ πᾶσαν κηλίδα τὴν ἐν αὐτῷ καταχρίσας.

verses.geez: ወገብረ፡ ቤተ፡ ዘውቅሮ፡ ዘሎቱ፡ ይደሉ፡ ወአንበሮ፡ ውስተ፡ መካን፡ ዘአውቀረ፡ ሎቱ፡ ወውስተ፡ አረፍት፡ አጥበቆ፡ ወአጽንዖ፡ በሐፂን።
verses.translation: and when he had made a convenient room for it, set it in a wall, and made it fast with iron:

translations.lxx: and when he had made a convenient room for it, set it in a wall, and made it fast with iron:
translations.ron: Apoi i-a făcut în perete bună aşezare, l-a pus acolo şi l-a întărit cu piroane de fier.
translations.grk: Καὶ ποιήσας αὐτῷ αὐτοῦ ἄξιον οἴκημα, ἐν τοίχῳ ἔθηκεν αὐτὸ ἀσφαλισάμενος σιδήρῳ·

verses.geez: ወአስተሐመመ፡ ቦቱ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይደቅ፡ አእሚሮ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይክል፡ ርእሶ፡ ረዲአ፡ እስመ፡ ምስል፡ ውእቱ፡ ወይፈቅድ፡ ዘይረድኦ።
verses.translation: for he provided for it that it might not fall, knowing that it was unable to help itself; for it is an image, and hath need of help.

translations.lxx: for he provided for it that it might not fall, knowing that it was unable to help itself; for it is an image, and hath need of help.
translations.ron: El are grijă de idol să nu cadă, ştiind bine că nu-şi poate ajuta singur, căci nu este decât un chip care are nevoie de ajutor.
translations.grk: ἵνα μὲν οὖν μὴ καταπέσῃ, προενόησεν αὐτοῦ, εἰδὼς ὅτι ἀδυνατεῖ ἑαυτῷ βοηθῆσαι, καὶ γάρ ἐστιν εἰκὼν, καὶ χρείαν ἔχει βοηθείας.

verses.geez: ወያስተበቊዕ፡ ኀቤሁ፡ በእንተ፡ ጥሪቱ፡ ወብእሲቱ፡ ወውሉዱ፡ ወኢየኀፍር፡ እንዘ፡ ይትናገር፡ ምስለ፡ ዘአልቦቱ፡ ነፍስ።
verses.translation: Then maketh he prayer for his goods, for his wife and children, and is not ashamed to speak to that which hath no life.

translations.lxx: Then maketh he prayer for his goods, for his wife and children, and is not ashamed to speak to that which hath no life.
translations.ron: Dar el se roagă chipului pentru averea sa, pentru nunţile sale şi pentru fiii săi şi nu se ruşinează a vorbi către lucrul cel neînsufleţit.
translations.grk: Περὶ δὲ κτημάτων καὶ γάμων αὐτοῦ καὶ τέκνων προσευχόμενος, οὐκ αἰσχύνεται τῷ ἀψύχῳ προσλαλῶν.

verses.geez: ወየኀሥሥ፡ በእንተ፡ ፈውስ፡ ኀበ፡ ድውይ፡ ወበእንተ፡ ሕይወትኒ፡ ምውተ፡ ይስእል፡ ወያስተበቊዕ፡ ኀበ፡ ዘአልቦቱ፡ አእምሮ፡ በእንተ፡ ንብረት፡ ወይትመሀለል።
verses.translation: For health he calleth upon that which is weak: for life prayeth to that which is dead: for aid humbly beseecheth that which hath least means to help: and for a good journey he asketh of that which cannot set a foot forward:

translations.lxx: For health he calleth upon that which is weak: for life prayeth to that which is dead: for aid humbly beseecheth that which hath least means to help: and for a good journey he asketh of that which cannot set a foot forward:
translations.ron: El cere sănătate de la cel neputincios, se roagă de viaţă celui mort şi de ajutor celui ce nu poate să dea nici unul; el se roagă de bună călătorie cui nu poate să meargă în picioare.
translations.grk: Καὶ περὶ μὲν ὑγείας τὸ ἀσθενὲς ἐπικαλεῖται, περὶ δὲ ζωῆς τὸν νεκρὸν ἀξιοῖ, περὶ δὲ ἐπικουρίας τὸν ἀπειρότατον ἱκετεύει, περὶ δὲ ὁδοιπορίας τὸ μηδὲ βάσει χρῆσθαι δυνάμενον,

verses.geez: ወበእንተ፡ ሐዊረ፡ ፍኖት፡ ይስእል፡ ኀበ፡ ዘኢይክል፡ ይትሐወስ፡ ወኢየሐውር፡ አሐተ፡ ምሥጋረ፡ ወበእንተ፡ ብዕል፡ ወምግባር፡ ወረኪብ፡ ወለአርትዖ፡ እግረ፡ እድ፡ ኀበ፡ ዘኢይገብራ፡ እደዊሁ፡ ምንተኒ፡ ይስእል፡ ወየኃሥሥ፡ እምኔሁ፡ ይጸግዎ፡ ኃይለ፡ ወአፍጥኖ፡ ምግባር።
verses.translation: and for gaining and getting, and for good success of his hands, asketh ability to do of him, that is most unable to do any thing.

translations.lxx: and for gaining and getting, and for good success of his hands, asketh ability to do of him, that is most unable to do any thing.
translations.ron: Ca să-şi pună la adăpost averea, alergătura şi izbânda muncii sale, el cere putere de la cel care are mâinile cele mai betege.
translations.grk: περὶ δὲ πορισμοῦ καὶ ἐργασίας καὶ χειρῶν ἐπιτυχίας τὸ ἀδρανέστατον ταῖς χερσὶν εὐδράνειαν αἰτεῖται.
